result.summary: Updates the `importdescriptors` RPC error message when a timestamp is missing to include the serialized JSON of the rejected request. A functional test is updated to check the new error string.
result.problem: When batch-importing multiple descriptors via `importdescriptors`, omitting a required timestamp throws a generic RPC error (`Missing required timestamp field for key`) that fails the entire call without indicating which descriptor in the batch caused the error.
evidence: Author description: "When importdescriptors is given multiple requests, a missing timestamp still fails the whole call with a static error... That does not say which request failed."
result.changed_since_previous: Dependency #34861 has been merged into master, removing the pending dependency requirement.
result.card: This PR modifies importdescriptors to include the serialized JSON of the offending request when throwing an RPC error for a missing timestamp. This helps users importing multiple descriptors at once identify which item in the array failed. No other participants have commented on the issue.

risk.why: Only changes the descriptive text in an RPC error message and adjusts an associated functional test.
